name: game-launcher
title: Game Launcher
description: Search and launch your installed Linux games (Steam, with more launchers to come)
author: DavidSeptimus

commands.name: search-games
commands.title: Search Games
commands.subtitle: Game Launcher
commands.description: Search your installed games and launch them, most recently played first

preferences.name: layout
preferences.title: Layout
preferences.description: Show games as an artwork grid or a compact list.

preferences.name: artwork
preferences.title: Grid Artwork
preferences.description: Which Steam artwork to show in the grid.

preferences.name: gridSize
preferences.title: Grid Size
preferences.description: Games per row. Auto picks a size that suits the artwork.

preferences.name: labels
preferences.title: Grid Labels
preferences.description: Text shown under each game in the grid.

preferences.name: steamPath
preferences.title: Steam Directory
preferences.description: Override Steam install detection (the folder that contains steamapps/). Leave empty to auto-detect native, Flatpak, and Snap installs.

preferences.name: includeNonGames
preferences.title: Steam Tools
preferences.label: Show Proton, runtimes, and other non-game Steam apps
preferences.description: Include Steam tools such as Proton and the Steam Linux Runtime in results.

preferences.name: artworkSource
preferences.title: Artwork Source
preferences.description: Steam's local cache only holds low-resolution art (300x450 covers, 32px icons). High resolution downloads sharper covers, banners and icons from Steam's CDN once and keeps them on disk.
